title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Patient presents for follow-up regarding management of T1DM and peripheral neuropathy.

History of Present Illness
The patient reports stable management of their type 1 diabetes mellitus. They continue to use long-term insulin therapy as prescribed. The patient also reports ongoing management of peripheral neuropathy symptoms. They deny any acute changes to these conditions since the last visit.

Medication List
Insulin (long-term use)

Exam
Vitals are stable. Neurological exam reveals mild diminished sensation noted in a stocking distribution consistent with peripheral neuropathy. Skin exam is intact.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus: Stable on insulin regimen.
2. Peripheral neuropathy: Stable status.

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen. Follow up in three months for routine assessment of T1DM and peripheral neuropathy. Patient educated on signs and symptoms requiring immediate medical attention.
explanations: Polyneuropathy is listed under 'with' for diabetes: E10.42.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: Coding separately misses the presumed link.
Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
